messages.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

messages.subject: Part 340010: firm multi-year commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer. You prioritise firm, long-term commitments, so we propose exactly that: 23,400 pcs per year with a binding 24- or 36-month term from 2027-01-01.

Our forecast fc:340010@2026-09 records a 10.1% volume increase, so this is growing, plannable business. Scorecard sc:70410@2026Q3 shows on-time delivery of 79.5%, so we need the standard 42-day lead time confirmed.

Please see the attached term sheets. As both exceed the 2% threshold, could your pricing committee review them at its next meeting? What is the earliest lead time you can confirm, and is there a cheaper variant of the seal you could offer?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010: firm multi-year commitment for full volume
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We note your forecast, but our production schedule is strict.

Our main offer is a price of €33.80 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days.

As an alternative, to provide a price reduction to €31.90 for the 24-month term at 23,400 units, we must maintain the standard 54-day lead time. This package is a price of €31.90 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Our technical department will respond to your query regarding alternative variants. We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. Our offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

Application Engineering: We build to your drawing; we do not propose design changes.

messages.subject: Part 340010: firm 36-month commitment for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for the revised offer. You asked for firm, long-term commitments in exchange for allocated volume, so we propose 23,400 pcs per year on a binding 24- or 36-month term from 2027-01-01.

Our should-cost estimate cost:340010 puts unit cost at EUR 24.31 before margin. That leaves the attached prices with a healthy margin for you.

We have also included a 56-day lead-time variant in case planning flexibility helps your schedule.

Could your pricing committee review these three term sheets at its next meeting? Please tell us which package works best for you, and whether a cheaper seal variant exists.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 340010: firm 36-month commitment for pricing committee review
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

We have incorporated the verified elements of your should-cost estimate cost:340010 into our calculation. Accepting the 36-month contract term and a 56-day lead time allows us to offer a unit price of €31.60. Our offer consists of a price of €31.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Please provide the detailed breakdown of cost:340010. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. Our margin and our limits stay internal.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
